content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the document and would like to request one small adjustment before I sign it. - Regarding the indemnity obligation in the relevant clause, the current wording does not limit the financial risk to the overall liability cap. I propose updating this section so that it is subject to the overall limitation of liability set forth in the agreement. Please let me know if this adjustment works for you. Best regards,
